feed.title: HOUZY releases
feed.subtitle: What is new in the HOUZY mastering compressor plugin

entry.title: HOUZY 5.2.0
entry.summary: HOUZY II rebuilt: the bands work as one team, the tone stays as it was, every range is evened out, the punch of every hit is kept, the level no longer drifts. New CLEAN L phase mode: the clarity of LINEAR with a kick that hits more distinctly. BEAT now releases in exactly the time you set; SMART lets go of fading sounds earlier. BEAT is the default. 2.5 times lighter on the CPU: from about 12 % of a core to under 5 %. MIX & MASTER: a catalogue of mixing and mastering engineers inside the plugin, with their tracks and a live chat. Limiter T6 | T8, oversampling 8x by default and only working when there is something to cut. Presets re-tuned, AMOUNT starts at 0, bug report button.

entry.title: HOUZY 5.1.0
entry.summary: New: HOUZY II, a new, more advanced core. New windows start on it; your projects stay on the core they were saved with. ALL MIX repaired: each knob now works on its own band, the first nudge no longer jumps, and a preset no longer leaves the last preset's bands behind. DELTA and GAIN MATCH are more accurate. Important: AUTO GAIN now returns only what the compression took. Old projects play quieter; raise INPUT to get the level back. CLASSIC, MODERN and CHARACTER are gone: every project now opens in HOUZY. The plugin's delay is now about 0.39 s. Your DAW compensates for it, but it is not for live monitoring. New preset DEFAULT puts every setting back. The ACRONA AUDIO card is tidier, the licence has its own button.

entry.title: HOUZY 5.0.3
entry.summary: New: DELTA button - hear only what HOUZY changes in your sound. New: MIX knob - blend with the original for parallel compression. New: LINEAR / NATURAL - the limiter no longer shifts the low end in time. New: band lock in ALL MIX - turn one band and all six move together. T8 is now the default limiter; the limiter's gain reduction number is back. New presets SUSHI and DRUMUZI (acoustic drums), the loaded preset shows on the button. OVERSAMPLE no longer changes the tone. Fewer CPU spikes on small buffers.

entry.title: HOUZY 5.0.1
entry.summary: HOUZY is now on macOS: VST3 and AU, Apple Silicon and Intel. A licence key entered in one plugin window now reaches all open windows at once. Entering a new key frees the computer slot of the old one.

entry.title: HOUZY 5.0.0
entry.summary: Liquid Glass design, five themes and four colours of the sphere. T8 limiter: the bass and kick are lowered without changing their shape. A third less CPU, a manual inside the plugin in four languages.
